item.title: SoundCloud adds ElevenLabs AI music integration
item.description:
SoundCloud adds ElevenLabs AI music integration

SoundCloud announced a new partnership with ElevenLabs, expanding its suite of generative AI music tools.

🔍 Overview

  • SoundCloud is partnering with another generative AI music service, ElevenLabs.
  • This follows an earlier partnership with Moises earlier this year.

⚙️ Integration Details

  • The integration allows songs generated by ElevenLabs to be published directly to SoundCloud.
  • Songs published from ElevenLabs will be labeled to make their AI origins clear.
  • The ElevenLabs integration isn’t as deep as the Moises integration.
  • Moises lets users pull tracks from SoundCloud for stem separation and remixing, then republish them directly to SoundCloud.

🎁 Artist Benefits

  • SoundCloud Artist Pro subscribers receive three months of ElevenMusic Pro for free, enabling experimentation with generative AI.

📍 Labeling & Compliance

  • SoundCloud encourages users subject to EU rules to label tracks as “AI‑generated or manipulated.”
  • The platform maintains rules against impersonation.

📊 Why it matters

  • SoundCloud appears more willing to embrace AI‑generated music than other streaming services.
  • It has avoided loud‑and‑proud press releases about removing spammy AI songs or demonetizing them.

#SoundCloud #ElevenLabs #AImusic #GenerativeAI

Source: You can post AI music straight to SoundCloud from ElevenLabs

item.title: Universal Music Group and ElevenLabs Partner to Launch AI Music Platform
item.description:
Universal Music Group and ElevenLabs Partner to Launch AI Music Platform

Universal Music Group (UMG) announced on Thursday the launch of a new AI-powered platform developed through a multiyear licensing agreement with ElevenLabs, a company specializing in AI voice and music generation.

🔍 Overview

The platform will allow users to utilize UMG’s catalog of licensed music to create:

  • Song remixes
  • Mashups
  • New takes on tracks

⚙️ Key details

  • Artist Participation: Artists can choose whether or not to participate in the platform.
  • Independence: The platform will remain separate from ElevenLabs’ Music API and ElevenMusic generator.
  • Future Development: The partnership includes the development of additional products and fan experiences in coming months and years, though specific details were not provided.

💡 Why it matters

ElevenLabs CEO Mati Staniszewski stated in the press release, “By combining UMG’s global community and rights management expertise, with our AI models and products, we’ll enable artists and songwriters to create powerful new experiences for their fans, and ensure they are fairly compensated.”

🧩 Context

UMG has established multiple AI licensing arrangements:

Partner Status/Detail
ElevenLabs Developing AI music platform
Udio Currently developing AI music platform
Spotify AI licensing deal
Nvidia AI licensing deal
Klay AI licensing deal
